tagline: Caribbean salsa nights at Café Havana, Bazurto Social Club's afro-Colombian residencies, and a December–April beach-club season.
summary: Cartagena's old walled city pairs nightly live salsa at Café Havana with afro-Colombian DJ programming at Bazurto Social Club, while Bocagrande and the islands run a December-through-April beach-club season anchored by the Hay Festival's January week and Caribbean carnival weekends.
whenToBook: Book Hay Festival weekend (mid-January) 8 weeks ahead; old town hotels are limited and fill quickly.
travelNotes: CTG sits 15 minutes from the walled city; stay inside the walls or in Getsemaní for music-tourism density. The Rosario Islands are 45 minutes by speedboat for day-trip beach clubs.
peakHook: January and February stack Hay Festival's literary-music week, dry-season beach club programming, and the run-up to coastal carnival weekends across the Colombian Caribbean.

heroScenes.peak: Cartagena walled city plaza at dusk in January, colonial Spanish architecture in pastel yellows and pinks, balconies with bougainvillea, soft warm light against a lavender Caribbean sky, no people, photographic
heroScenes.shoulder: Cartagena Bocagrande beachfront in late afternoon March light, palm trees casting long shadows on white sand, calm Caribbean blue water, distant Old City spires, no people
heroScenes.detail: interior of a Cartagena Getsemaní bar at night, brass ceiling fan, a single mojito on a rough-hewn wooden bar, faded Cuban poster on a peeling-paint wall, low golden light, no people

blueprints.title: Hay Festival Cartagena
blueprints.summary: Latin America's flagship literature festival pairs four days of talks with concert programming across the walled city, drawing international Latin and afro-Caribbean acts to plaza stages.

blueprints.title: Café Havana live salsa nights
blueprints.summary: Café Havana's nightly Cuban salsa orchestra is Cartagena's defining live-music ritual — a packed dance floor in Getsemaní that runs Tuesday through Sunday across the dry season.

blueprints.title: Bazurto Social Club Friday programming
blueprints.summary: Bazurto Social Club's Friday nights blend afro-Colombian champeta and electronic crossover with live percussion — the city's reference room for Caribbean dance music.
